With strong profitability (EBIT margin ≈ 33% and net margin ≈ 21%) and a solid equity base (equity ≈ 48% of assets), the company shows good earnings capacity and balance-sheet support. However, liquidity appears weak with current assets (1,047M) below current liabilities (1,322M), and EBIT only modestly covers near-term obligations (EBIT/Current liabilities ≈ 1.2x), tempering the credit quality.  

DECISION: BBB+
